limitations: Weak one-ply policy, not a human or strong chess engine
Tactical fixtures are synthetic, not proven reachable through a natural opening
Seeded arms diverge after different actions; not a causal estimate of universal hero strength

No all-mutation, Android, network, global balance or independent QA claim
